data.message: Individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal: I commit to 18 tons. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if filled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Other allocations need recalculation. Recovery isn't guaranteed; this may not maximize long-run income. Intentions aren't enforceable. Will you opt for18 even if others choose10?
